text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, long time no see! I was so 
lonely not being able to see you~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I had tons of fun playing over the 
break, but...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"When I realized that Trainer-chan wasn't 
by my side..."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...I just really wanted to see you.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So, to make up for being lonely, I'm gonna 
indulge in my Trainer-chan to the max!♪

Having gotten plenty of rest, she seemed 
to be brimming with energy.
